messages:
jules: FYI I’m seeing a small but persistent tail of fncall schema errors on /orders.create (route=orders_create_v3). Mostly 'enum_mismatch' and some 'missing_required'. Hitting ~0.8% of calls for the last 4 hours.
arjun: Same. The strange bit: some adapters return a nested object with keys as strings that look like numbers, e.g., {"0": {...}, "1": {...} } instead of an array. Our validator treats that as object vs array mismatch.
tess: Small ask: can we emit a more descriptive metric instead of only fncall.validation.fail? Something like fncall.validation.reason and a sample_rate tag so we can instrument high-volume routes without huge cardinality.
jules: Agreed. Proposal: reason in [enum_mismatch, missing_key, object_instead_of_array, type_mismatch], plus adapter and route tags and sample_rate. Keep sample_rate default 0.01 for production routes.
arjun: Also we should add a severity metric: validation.action = {reject, soft_fallback, autocorrected}. That helps dashboard owners separate noisy rejects vs graceful fallbacks.
tess: On autocorrected: we already have a tiny autocorrect for common enums (e.g., uppercase/lowercase). Need to log autocorrected=true in traces so QA can validate.
jules: Console UX idea: offer per-route default and per-customer override. E.g., route default STRICT, but customer A can opt into SOFT. Show an estimated cost delta on the toggle based on recent traffic.
arjun: Critical billing note: when we soft-fallback to free-text or degen, billing currently attributes to the last model. That hides primary model cost and makes refunds/updating customer quotas hard. We should add attribution_tags tokens_split=[primary:XX,fallback:YY] or emit tokens.charged.primary and tokens.charged.fallback metrics.
tess: For dashboards: please keep cardinality low: we should not tag tokens metrics with full customer_id; use customer_tier or a hashed id. For debug traces keep a sampled mapping.
infra-bot: nightly-collector: validation-trace-sample job scheduled (sample_rate=0.01) :bookmark_tabs:
jules: Implementation plan: runtime change -> emit reason + action + sample_rate applied, traces stored to validation-traces (7d) with redaction. Console change -> per-route toggle + per-customer override + cost estimate. Billing change -> split tokens metric.
arjun: Edgecase: when adapter returns both an array and an object (e.g., items: {list: [...], summary: {...}}) our path reporting should point to the exact JSON path and the expected schema node. That aids adapters in fixing.
tess: Please scrub PII before storing traces. Minimum redaction: card_number, cvv, ssn, email, name. Legal: any retention >24h needs signoff.
legal: Confirmed. 24h default retention for raw traces, can request 7d with justification. All traces must be redacted as described.
jules: For rollout, two-stage: 1) add telemetry only (reason + action) and dashboard panels + alert tweaks; 2) pilot soft-fallback toggle for internal customers only with billing split enabled.
arjun: Can we add an SLO guard? e.g., if a customer’s soft-fallback rate >0.5% for 10m, automatically revert to STRICT for them to avoid silent regressions.
tess: Good call. Add a per-customer cap and an auto-revert policy with notification.
infra-bot: canary deploy fncall-validation v3 started (canary=4 routes) :rocket:
jules: Logging snippet for runtime (pseudo):
```
{"ts": 1610000000, "route": "orders_create_v3", "validation": {"ok": false, "reason": "object_instead_of_array", "path": "items", "action": "soft_fallback", "sampled": true}}
```
arjun: Keep that JSON in logs only. Traces store the redacted payload separately and link back via trace_id.
tess: Dev tasks: add reason enum and action flags, implement per-route sample_rate, wire up sampled traces to validation-traces bucket with 24h retention. Ops tasks: new Grafana panels + alert rule for reason spikes. Billing tasks: tokens split metrics. Console tasks: toggle + cost estimate + auto-revert cap UI.
jules: Timeline: telemetry + dashboard by Thu EOD, soft-fallback pilot next Mon for internal customers, open beta after pilot.
infra-bot: canary deploy fncall-validation v3 succeeded on 4 routes (status=ok) :white_check_mark:
jules: Thanks. If anyone sees a new surge after canary ping here and add logs/trace_ids.
